metadata.evidence: # SGDLibrary : Stochastic Optimization Algorithm Library in MATLAB/Octave
metadata.reason: Names the main repository / library project.

metadata.value: The SGDLibrary is a **pure-MATLAB** library or toolbox of a collection of **stochastic optimization algorithms**. This solves an unconstrained minimization problem of the form, min f(x) = sum_i f_i(x).
